source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 13 (Halogens) ki exercise hal ke saath (PDF 302-304): MCQs ke jawab aur wajah, short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 (Halogens) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain. Jahan kitab mein ghalti hai wahan "Kitab ki ghalti" box hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. Which halogen molecule has the strongest bond?
(Kis halogen molecule ka bond sab se mazboot hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bond energies (Table 13.3): F₂ 156, Cl₂ 243, Br₂ 193, I₂ 151 kJ mol⁻¹. Sab se zyada Cl₂ ki hai. F₂ ka bond kamzor hai kyun ke chhote atoms ki wajah se lone pairs qareeb aa kar ek doosre ko dhakelte hain (repulsion) (13.3).

blocks.prompt:
II. The volatility of the halogens (Group 17) generally _________ as you move down the group (from Fluorine to Iodine).
(Group 17 mein neeche jate hue (fluorine se iodine tak) halogens ki volatility (aasani se bukharat banna) aam tor par ______ hai.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche jate hue molecules bare aur zyada polarizable hote hain, is liye London dispersion forces mazboot, boiling point zyada aur volatility kam hoti hai (13.1, 13.2).

blocks.prompt:
III. Which one of the following halogen molecules has strongest oxidizing power?
(In mein se kis halogen molecule ki oxidizing power sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidizing power group mein neeche ghatti hai: F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂. F₂ ka E° sab se zyada positive (+2.87 V) hai (13.4).

blocks.prompt:
IV. The decreasing thermal stability of the halogens down the group is primarily due to the:
(Group mein neeche halogens ki thermal stability (garmi mein na tootne ki salahiyat) kam hone ki asal wajah kya hai?)

options.text: Halogen atoms ke darmiyan bond length kam hona
Atomic radius barhna, jis se covalent bond kamzor hota hai
Van der Waals forces ka mazboot hona

blocks.explanation: Neeche jate hue atomic radius barhta hai, bond lamba aur orbitals ka overlap kam ho jata hai, is liye bond kamzor ho kar garmi se jaldi toot jata hai. Chapter yeh baat hydrogen halides (HF > HCl > HBr > HI, 13.6) aur Cl₂ se I₂ tak halogen molecules (13.3) ke liye batata hai.

blocks.prompt:
V. Which one of the following halides has strongest reducing power?
(In mein se kis halide ki reducing power sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halide ions ki reducing power: I⁻ > Br⁻ > Cl⁻ > F⁻. I⁻ sab se bara ion hai aur us ki charge density sab se kam, is liye woh electron sab se aasani se deta hai (13.7).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options ke labels a), b), b), d) chhape hain: teesra option Br⁻ doosri dafa "b)" chhapa hai. Yeh option (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
VI. Which statement about the reaction between halogens and hydrogen is correct?
(Halogens aur hydrogen ke reaction ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Iodine hydrogen se sab se tezi se react karta hai
Chlorine aur hydrogen andhere mein phat parte hain
Fluorine thande aur andhere mein bhi hydrogen se dhamake ke saath milta hai
Bromine aur hydrogen bilkul react nahi karte

blocks.explanation: F₂ thande aur andhere mein bhi H₂ se dhamake ke saath milta hai. Cl₂ ko UV roshni ya chingari chahiye, Br₂ garam karne par milta hai, aur I₂ catalyst ke saath ahista aur reversible tor par (13.5).

blocks.prompt:
VII. How does the acidic strength of hydrogen halides change as you move down the group?
(Group mein neeche jate hue hydrogen halides ki acidic strength kaise badalti hai?)

options.text: HF se HI tak ghatti hai
HF se HI tak barhti hai

blocks.explanation: Neeche jate hue H–X bond kamzor hota hai (H–F 569, H–Cl 431, H–Br 366, H–I 299 kJ mol⁻¹, Table 13.5), is liye paani mein H⁺ aasani se nikalta hai: HF < HCl < HBr < HI.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Why is fluorine the most reactive halogen?
(Fluorine sab se zyada reactive halogen kyun hai?)

options.text: Halogen molecule mein bond ki mazbooti
Halogen molecule mein electrons ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: Halogen ki reactivity us ke electron lene ke rujhan par hai; fluorine sab se zyada electronegative element hai, is liye sab se aasani se F⁻ banata hai (13.4). Kamzor F–F bond (156 kJ mol⁻¹) bhi madad karta hai, magar asal wajah electronegativity hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX. When aqueous silver nitrate is added to a solution containing bromide ions, a cream precipitate forms. What is the solubility of this precipitate in ammonia solution?
(Bromide ions wale mehlool mein aqueous silver nitrate dalne se cream rang ka precipitate banta hai. Yeh ammonia solution mein kitna hal hota hai?)

options.text: Dilute ammonia mein hal ho jata hai
Dilute ammonia mein thora sa hal hota hai
Dilute ammonia mein bilkul hal nahi hota
Sirf ammonia ke saath garam karne par hal hota hai

blocks.explanation: AgBr thora sa hi hal hota hai: dilute ammonia mein poora hal nahi hota (AgCl ho jata hai) aur concentrated ammonia mein hal hota hai (13.8, Table 13.6). Is liye dilute ammonia mein partially soluble (thora hal) hai; insoluble AgI hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: AgCl safed, dilute NH₃ mein hal; AgBr cream, sirf concentrated NH₃ mein (dilute mein thora); AgI peela, kisi NH₃ mein hal nahi.

blocks.prompt:
X. Concentrated sulfuric acid is added to solid sodium chloride. What is the initial observation?
(Thos sodium chloride mein concentrated sulfuric acid dala jaye to pehle kya nazar aata hai?)

options.text: Hydrogen chloride ke bhaap jaise safed fumes nikalte hain

blocks.explanation: NaCl(s) + H₂SO₄(l) → NaHSO₄ + HCl(g): HCl ke bhaap jaise safed fumes. Cl⁻ kamzor reducing agent hai, H₂SO₄ ko reduce nahi karta, is liye Cl₂ nahi banti. Bhoore fumes (Br₂) bromide se aur jamni bhaap (I₂) iodide se aati hai (13.9).

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar jawab wale sawal)
Q.2 Neeche diye gaye mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. Which halogen is the least reactive, which is the most? Why?
Kaun sa halogen sab se kam reactive hai aur kaun sa sab se zyada? Kyun?
blocks.explanation:
Sab se zyada reactive: fluorine; sab se kam (F, Cl, Br, I mein): iodine.
Wajah: reactivity electron lene par munhasir hai. Fluorine sab se chhota aur sab se zyada electronegative hai, F–F bond kamzor aur E° sab se zyada (+2.87 V). Iodine sab se bara, kam electronegative aur E° sab se kam (+0.54 V).

blocks.prompt:
b. The ionic equation for a reaction is:
Br₂ + 2I⁻ →Br⁻ + I₂.
c. Explain which species is oxidized in this reaction. Why?
b. Ek reaction ki ionic equation di gayi hai. c. Batayein is reaction mein kaun sa species oxidize hota hai aur kyun?
blocks.explanation:
I⁻ oxidize hota hai: har iodide ion ek electron deta hai, aur oxidation state −1 se I₂ mein 0 ho jati hai (2I⁻ → I₂ + 2e⁻).
Br₂ reduce hota hai (0 se −1) aur oxidizing agent hai. Wajah: Br₂, I₂ se mazboot oxidizing agent hai (E° +1.07 V aur +0.54 V), is liye bromine iodine ko nikal deta hai (displace).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Equation balanced nahi chhapi: Br₂ + 2I⁻ → Br⁻ + I₂. Ek Br₂ molecule do bromide ions deta hai. Durust: Br₂ + 2I⁻ → 2Br⁻ + I₂.

blocks.prompt:
d. What is role of London dispersion forces in the trend of volatility of halogens?
Halogens ki volatility ke trend mein London dispersion forces ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Halogens non-polar hain, is liye sirf London (id-id) forces in ke molecules ko jorti hain. Neeche jate hue molecules bare aur zyada polarizable (electron badal aasani se bigarne wala) hote hain, forces mazboot hoti hain; molecules alag karne ko zyada energy chahiye, boiling point barhta aur volatility ghatti hai (F₂, Cl₂ gas; Br₂ liquid; I₂ thos).

blocks.prompt:
e. How does the reactivity of halogens with hydrogen vary?
Hydrogen ke saath halogens ki reactivity kaise badalti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh group mein neeche ghatti hai: F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂.
F₂ thande aur andhere mein bhi H₂ se dhamaka karta hai; Cl₂ UV roshni ya chingari mein; Br₂ garam karne par; I₂ zyada temperature aur catalyst ke saath ahista aur reversible (H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI).

blocks.prompt:
f. Which halogen is used as an antiseptic? How does it work?
Kaun sa halogen antiseptic ke tor par istemal hota hai? Yeh kaise kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Iodine (tincture of iodine, yani iodine ka alcohol mein mehlool) chhote zakhmon par antiseptic ke tor par lagaya jata hai (Chapter 16 mein tincture iodine zakhm ke disinfectant ke tor par likha hai).
Yeh oxidizing agent hai: bacteria aur doosre jaraseem ke proteins aur enzymes ko oxidize kar ke unhein maar deta hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
g. What is the colour change when chlorine displaces bromine?
Jab chlorine bromine ko displace karti hai to rang kaise badalta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Cl₂ + 2Br⁻ → 2Cl⁻ + Br₂
Be-rang bromide mehlool (maslan KBr) mein chlorine water dalne se mehlool orange se laal-bhoora ho jata hai kyun ke azad bromine banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
h. How the halogen acids are ionized in water?
Halogen acids paani mein kaise ionize hote hain?
blocks.explanation:
Hydrogen halides paani mein hal ho kar H⁺ (H₃O⁺) aur halide ions dete hain:
HX(g) + H₂O(l) → H₃O⁺(aq) + X⁻(aq)
HCl, HBr aur HI poori tarah ionize hote hain (strong acids); HF sirf thora (weak acid): HF + H₂O ⇌ H₃O⁺ + F⁻ (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
i. Why HF is weaker acid than HCl?
HF, HCl se kamzor acid kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: H–F bond (569 kJ mol⁻¹), H–Cl bond (431 kJ mol⁻¹) se bohat mazboot hai kyun ke F chhota hai aur H se zyada overlap karta hai. Is liye HF paani mein mushkil se H⁺ deta hai aur thora ionize hota hai, jabke HCl poori tarah. (HF mein hydrogen bonding bhi H ko pakarti hai, chapter se aage.)

blocks.prompt:
j. Describe a simple chemical test that could be used to distinguish between aqueous solutions of potassium bromide and potassium iodide. Include the reagents and expected observations.
Potassium bromide aur potassium iodide ke aqueous mehlool mein farq karne ka ek aasan chemical test bayan karein, reagents aur mushahidaat samet.
blocks.explanation:
Silver nitrate test, phir ammonia: har mehlool mein thora dilute HNO₃ aur phir aqueous AgNO₃ dalein.
KBr: AgBr ka cream precipitate, jo concentrated NH₃(aq) mein hal ho jata hai.
KI: AgI ka peela precipitate, jo dilute aur concentrated dono NH₃ mein hal nahi hota.
Ag⁺ + Br⁻ → AgBr(s); Ag⁺ + I⁻ → AgI(s)

rows: Precipitate dilute aur concentrated NH₃ mein hal nahi

blocks.prompt:
k. Explain the chemical principles behind the use of chlorine as a disinfectant in water purification. Include relevant chemical equations in your explanation.
Paani saaf karne mein chlorine ke disinfectant (jaraseem kush) ke tor par istemal ke chemical usool equations ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Chlorine paani mein hydrolysis karti hai: Cl₂(g) + H₂O(l) → HCl(aq) + HClO(aq)
2. Chloric(I) acid (hypochlorous acid) weak acid hai, thora toot'ta hai: HOCl ⇌ H⁺ + OCl⁻
3. HOCl aur OCl⁻ asal kaam karne wale species hain. Yeh bacteria ke proteins, lipids, enzymes aur nucleic acids ko oxidize kar ke unhein maar dete hain.
4. HOCl zyada asar wala hai kyun ke yeh neutral hai aur cell wall ke paar aasani se jata hai; pH 6–7.5 par yahi zyada hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
l. Describe one significant disadvantage associated with the use of chlorine in water purification.
Paani saaf karne mein chlorine ke istemal ka ek bara nuqsan bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Chlorine paani mein maujood organic maadde se mil kar chlorine wale by-products (maslan trihalomethanes jaise chloroform) banati hai jo lambe arse mein sehat ke liye nuqsan deh ho sakte hain (chapter se aage).
Is ke ilawa chlorine gas khud bohat zehreeli hai, is liye is ko rakhna aur sahi miqdar dalna bari ehtiyat mangta hai (13.11).

blocks.prompt:
m. What is disproportionation reaction? Give an example.
Disproportionation reaction kya hai? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation:
Woh reaction jis mein ek hi element ek waqt mein oxidize bhi ho aur reduce bhi.
Misal: Cl₂(g) + 2NaOH(aq, thanda) → NaCl(aq) + NaClO(aq) + H₂O(l)
Chlorine 0 (Cl₂) se −1 (NaCl, reduce) aur +1 (NaClO, oxidize) ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
n. Chlorine gas reacts differently with sodium hydroxide solution depending on the temperature and concentration.
o. Write balanced chemical equations for the reaction of chlorine (Cl₂) with:
i) Cold, dilute sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
ii) Hot, concentrated sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
n. Chlorine gas sodium hydroxide ke saath temperature aur concentration ke mutabiq mukhtalif tarah react karti hai. o. Chlorine ki (i) thande, dilute NaOH aur (ii) garam, concentrated NaOH ke saath balanced equations likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i) Thanda, dilute NaOH:
Cl₂(g) + 2NaOH(aq) → NaCl(aq) + NaClO(aq) + H₂O(l)
(sodium chlorate(I), yani sodium hypochlorite)
ii) Garam, concentrated NaOH:
3Cl₂(g) + 6NaOH(aq) → 5NaCl(aq) + NaClO₃(aq) + 3H₂O(l)
(sodium chlorate(V))

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter mein garam NaOH wali equation 3Cl₂ + 6NaOH → NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O chhapi hai jo balanced nahi. Exam mein 5NaCl likhein: 6 Cl mein se 5 reduce ho kar Cl⁻ aur 1 oxidize ho kar ClO₃⁻ banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
p. For each reaction in question l), identify the oxidation states of chlorine in the reactant (Cl₂) and in each of the chlorine-containing products. Use these oxidation states to explain why both reactions are classified as disproportionation reactions.
Sawal (o) ke har reaction mein Cl₂ aur chlorine wale har product mein chlorine ki oxidation states batayein, aur in se wazeh karein ke dono reactions disproportionation kyun hain.
blocks.explanation:
Thanda NaOH: Cl₂ = 0; NaCl = −1; NaClO = +1.
Garam NaOH: Cl₂ = 0; NaCl = −1; NaClO₃ = +5.
Dono reactions mein ek hi element, chlorine (0), ka kuch hissa reduce (−1) aur kuch hissa ek hi waqt mein oxidize (+1 ya +5) hota hai, is liye dono disproportionation reactions hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal "question l)" ka hawala deta hai, magar thande aur garam NaOH ki equations hissa o) mein hain. Murad hai: hissa o) ke har reaction ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 Describe and explain the relative thermal stabilities of the halogen hydrides in terms of bonds strength.
Halogen hydrides ki thermal stability ka muqabla bond ki mazbooti ki buniyad par bayan aur wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Hydrogen halide ki thermal stability ka matlab hai garam karne par H₂ aur X₂ mein na tootna. Yeh H–X bond ki mazbooti par munhasir hai.
Thermal stability ki tarteeb: HF > HCl > HBr > HI
Bond dissociation energies (Table 13.5): H–F 569, H–Cl 431, H–Br 366, H–I 299 kJ mol⁻¹.
1. HF: fluorine chhota aur bohat electronegative hai; orbitals ka zyada overlap bohat mazboot H–F bond banata hai, is liye HF sab se stable hai.
2. HCl: chlorine bara hai, H–Cl bond lamba aur kamzor, is liye HF se kam stable.
3. HBr: bromine aur bara; kam overlap se H–Br bond aur kamzor.
4. HI: iodine ka radius bohat bara; bohat kam overlap se H–I bond sab se kamzor, is liye HI sab se kam stable (garam taar se HI toot kar jamni iodine bhaap deta hai, chapter se aage).
Nateeja: neeche jate hue atomic radius aur bond length barhti, bond energy ghatti aur thermal stability kam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q 4. Discuss the relative reactivity of the halogen elements as oxidizing agents. Arrange F₂, Cl₂, Br₂, I₂ in increasing order of the oxidizing power.
Halogens ki oxidizing agents ke tor par reactivity ka muqabla karein. F₂, Cl₂, Br₂, I₂ ko oxidizing power ki barhti tarteeb mein likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Halogens oxidizing agents hain: electrons le kar halide ions bante hain, maslan 2Na(s) + Cl₂(g) → 2NaCl(s).
Oxidizing power group mein neeche ghatti hai kyun ke electron lene ka rujhan kam hota hai.
1. Standard electrode potentials E°(X₂/X⁻): F₂ +2.87 V, Cl₂ +1.36 V, Br₂ +1.07 V, I₂ +0.54 V. Jitna zyada positive E°, utna mazboot oxidizing agent.
2. Displacement (nikal dena): har halogen apne neeche wale halide ions ko oxidize karta hai.
F₂ + 2Cl⁻ → 2F⁻ + Cl₂ (F₂, Cl⁻, Br⁻ aur I⁻ sab ko)
Cl₂ + 2Br⁻ → 2Cl⁻ + Br₂; Cl₂ + 2I⁻ → 2Cl⁻ + I₂
Br₂ + 2I⁻ → 2Br⁻ + I₂
Iodine kisi halide ion ko oxidize nahi kar sakti.
3. Asbab (factors): kam dissociation energy, zyada electron affinity aur ions ki zyada hydration energy (aur Br₂, I₂ ke liye heat of vaporization) wala halogen zyada oxidizing hai. Fluorine ka F–F bond kamzor aur F⁻ ion bohat chhota (zyada hydration energy), is liye yeh sab se mazboot hai.
Oxidizing power ki barhti tarteeb: I₂ < Br₂ < Cl₂ < F₂

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter mein F₂ + Cl⁻ → F⁻ + Cl₂ jaisi equations balanced nahi chhapi. Exam mein hamesha 2Cl⁻ aur 2F⁻ likhein: F₂ + 2Cl⁻ → 2F⁻ + Cl₂.

blocks.prompt:
Q 5. Describe the reactions that occur when chlorine is bubbled through
(i) Cold and (ii) Hot, aqueous sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
Chlorine ko (i) thande aur (ii) garam aqueous NaOH mein guzarne par hone wale reactions bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dono disproportionation reactions hain: chlorine (0) ek hi waqt mein oxidize aur reduce hoti hai; products temperature par munhasir hain.
(i) Thanda, dilute NaOH:
Cl₂(g) + 2NaOH(aq) → NaCl(aq) + NaClO(aq) + H₂O(l)
Products: sodium chloride aur sodium chlorate(I) (sodium hypochlorite).
Cl ki oxidation states: Cl₂ 0 → NaCl −1 (reduce) aur NaClO +1 (oxidize).
(ii) Garam, concentrated NaOH:
3Cl₂(g) + 6NaOH(aq) → 5NaCl(aq) + NaClO₃(aq) + 3H₂O(l)
Products: sodium chloride aur sodium chlorate(V).
Cl ki oxidation states: Cl₂ 0 → NaCl −1 (paanch Cl atoms reduce) aur NaClO₃ +5 (ek Cl atom oxidize).
Garam karne par pehle bana chlorate(I) mazeed toot kar chloride aur chlorate(V) deta hai (chapter se aage: 3ClO⁻ → 2Cl⁻ + ClO₃⁻). Yeh reactions dikhate hain ke temperature products ko kaise badalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 Discuss the reducing power of halide ions with relevant reactions. Also explain the factors affecting it.
Halide ions ki reducing power reactions ke saath bayan karein. Is par asar dalne wale factors bhi wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Halide ions ki reducing power group mein neeche barhti hai: F⁻ < Cl⁻ < Br⁻ < I⁻ (I⁻ sab se mazboot, F⁻ sab se kamzor).
Factors:
1. Ion ka size: I⁻ sab se bara ion hai; bahar wala electron nucleus se door hai aur aasani se nikal jata hai. F⁻ bohat chhota hai.
2. Electronegativity: F se I tak ghatti hai, is liye extra electron par pakar kamzor hoti hai.
3. Charge density: F⁻ ki charge density zyada hai jo use mustahkam (stable) rakhti hai; I⁻ ki kam hai, woh aasani se electron deta hai.
Concentrated sulfuric acid ke saath reactions yeh trend dikhate hain (13.9):
1. F⁻: NaF + H₂SO₄ → NaHSO₄ + HF (sirf HF fumes; redox nahi)
2. Cl⁻: NaCl + H₂SO₄ → NaHSO₄ + HCl (sirf HCl fumes; Cl⁻ H₂SO₄ ko reduce nahi karta)
3. Br⁻: NaBr + H₂SO₄ → NaHSO₄ + HBr, phir 2HBr + H₂SO₄ → Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O
HBr, H₂SO₄ (S +6) ko SO₂ (S +4) tak reduce karta aur khud bhoori Br₂ ban jata hai.
4. I⁻: NaI + H₂SO₄ → NaHSO₄ + HI, phir 8HI + H₂SO₄ → 4I₂ + H₂S + 4H₂O
HI, H₂SO₄ (S +6) ko H₂S (S −2) tak reduce karta aur jamni I₂ deta hai, is liye I⁻ sab se mazboot reducing agent hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter mein HBr wali equation 2HBr + H₂SO₄ → Br₂ + 2SO₂ + 2H₂O chhapi hai jo balanced nahi; durust sirf ek SO₂ hai. Aur HBr, HI ko (s) nahi (g) likhein.
